newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Chemserv in 14 million rand joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Chemserv in 14 million rand joint venture.

text.p: South African chemicals manufacturer Chemical Services Ltd announced on Thursday it had purchased a 50 percent stake in a.b.e Industrial Products Pty Ltd for 14 million rand.
a.b.e Industrial Products, a construction products manufacturer, is a unit of Murray & Roberts Contractors ltd.
Chemical Services said in a statement the equal joint venture would considerably strengthen its position in the construction chemicals sector.
It said a.b.e, which will be renamed a.b.e Construction Chemicals, was also in negotiations for the purchase of the Zimbabwean arm of concrete ingredients supplier Fosroc.
Chemical Services said Lex van Vught had been appointed executive chairman after Mike Sander's earlier retirement from the chairman's post.
